content: Typeform has two UTM mechanisms: (1) native 'UTM Tracking' toggle under form Settings > Tracking that auto-captures utm_source/medium/campaign/term/content without defining hidden fields, reported as gated to paid/Business plans; (2) free Hidden Fields / URL Parameters mechanism where you manually define hidden fields named utm_source etc. and pass matching query params on the link to the form. Third-party tools (Attributer, LeadSources) layer cookie-based first-touch persistence on top since raw URL params are lost if the visitor doesn't convert on the same page/session.
